18 October 2023
Added AmazonOpenSearchIn
gestionServiceRole
Policy
A new policy that allows
OpenSearch Ingestion
to enable VPC access for
ingestion pipelines, create
tags, and publish ingestion-
related CloudWatch metrics
to your account.
For the policy JSON, see the
IAM console.

gestionFullAccess
A new policy that grants full
access to the OpenSearch

account.

IAM console.

rverlessServiceRol

Added the permissions

olePolicy

been updated to ensure
backwards compatibility.

IAM console.

n necessary for the service-
linked role to verify and
validate ACM resources in
order to create and update
custom endpoint enabled
domains.
The deprecated Elasticse
arch policy has also
been updated to ensure
backwards compatibility.
